PCBWay fabrication exports
==========================

Generated from the combined two-island KiCad 10.99 master via a temporary KiCad 10.0.x compatibility copy.
Target order: FR-4, 4 layers, 1.0 mm, 1 oz finished outer copper, 1 oz inner copper.
Gerbers are emitted as classic RS-274-X (X2/netlist attributes disabled) with Protel extensions.
Each ZIP contains one physical PCB only: four copper layers, solder masks, silkscreens, Edge.Cuts and separate PTH/NPTH Excellon drill files.
F.Paste/B.Paste are intentionally omitted because they are stencil/assembly data, not bare-PCB fabrication layers.
Regenerate these files after every PCB change; do not edit the sliced temporary boards.
